title: Shader Forge: Channel Mixer & Distortion Lab
description: The user operates a shader laboratory where an AnimatedMorphCube orbits a central ShaderBall. By adjusting sliders and clicking buttons, the user transfers visual shader effects from the cube onto the ShaderBall, mixing chromatic aberration, vertex displacement, fresnel glow, and dissolve noise channels in real time.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive shader laboratory. Load AnimatedMorphCube.glb and ShaderBall.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the ShaderBall at the scene center and the AnimatedMorphCube orbiting it at radius 3 with a slow automatic rotation. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0,2,6) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.4) and a DirectionalLight from (5,8,5) with intensity 1.2. Play any morph animations on the cube via AnimationMixer. Replace the ShaderBall material with a custom ShaderMaterial using uniforms: uTime (float), uChromatic (float 0-1), uDisplacement (float 0-1), uFresnel (float 0-1), uDissolve (float 0-1), uActiveChannels (int). The vertex shader should apply sine-based vertex displacement scaled by uDisplacement. The fragment shader should combine: chromatic aberration splitting RGB normals by uChromatic, a fresnel rim glow effect controlled by uFresnel using view-dot-normal, and a procedural 3D noise dissolve that discards fragments below uDissolve threshold. Create an HTML overlay panel with: (1) four range sliders labeled Chromatic, Displacement, Fresnel, and Dissolve each controlling their respective uniform from 0.0 to 1.0, (2) a 'Transfer From Cube' button that when clicked reads the current morph influence of the cube and maps it to boost all four shader values by 0.2 (clamped to 1.0) with a brief flash animation on the cube, (3) a 'Reset Channels' button that animates all four uniforms back to 0 over 500ms, (4) a channel counter display showing how many channels are above 0.5 threshold stored in uActiveChannels. Validate that the user must activate at least 3 channels above 0.5 and perform at least one transfer from the cube. The cube should pulse with emissive color intensity proportional to the average of all four uniform values. Update uTime each frame for animated shader effects. Style the overlay with a dark semi-transparent panel on the left side.
